spans.text: Fixed a bug where alien artefacts could not be deposited in the currency tab.

Fixed a bug where repairing all items could result in an error for good this time. As a side effect, repair cost displayed might be off in rare cases by a small margin (game always takes the server repair cost now).
Fixed a critical bug where most items that granted x% physical damage as ele damage were not working at all (e.g. Voidforge).
Fixed a bug where Ironbolt was getting twice the intended life on striking.
Fixed a bug where life pact drained twice the amount of life intended.
Fixed a bug where Ravens would not attack until a point in thunderclaws was learned.
Fixed a bug where Ravens’ default damage was not taken into consideration.
Fixed a bug where levitation mastery oskill (or any other passive mastery) would break auras for a very short period of time.
Fixed a bug where certain blacksmith nodes would bug out certain runeworded weapons.
Fixed a display bug where a bound monster wouldn’t list its aura in the monster display description.
Diablo
- Significantly reduced the damage of his lightning inferno. Reduced the damage of his fire nova by ~33%. Increased firestorm damage by ~100%.
Andariel
- Reduced her poison damage. The physical part of her poison skills no longer scales exponentially with levels.
Reworked a few more unique items, added a few new cool skills.
Removed ascendancy stones from the game.
Moved the entire ascendancy system in a new UI panel that can be accessed by clicking the button near the specializations (character sheet) once you unlock ascendancies.
The orb of creation is now a consumable that unlocks the ascendancy panel.

All boss kills now work off the plugin directly (based on d2rloader sdk). The kill credit should now be significantly more reliable and never fail. The kills are credited to everyone in the area of the boss. This includes kills for kill ledger bonuses and the rathma charm.
Entering a character that already has an ascendancy stone will instantly destroy that stone and automatically ascend that character to the intended tier (the ascendancy is transferred to the panel).
Changed the lich king bonus. No longer grants 1 to all skills. Instead, it now grants 10% bonus effect to the special tier 3 and 4 bonuses.
Please report any bugs, this is a substantial migration.
Bind Monster

- Reduced damage by ~50%. Swapping a permanent consume effect book to another book with a similar effect (e.g. ars’tor-baalos to ars’al-diabolos) will make the previous consume effect expire instantly. You will not be able to bind multiple prime evils anymore.
Fixed a crash and projectile bug with unravelers.
Fixed a bug with monsters rolling invalid auras.
Binding certain bosses should now roll a random aura properly and not just blessed aim.
Fixed a bug where magic items could not be corrupted.
Fixed a bug with certain gear slots getting the same corruptions every time.
Fixed a bug with rings of power and my precious jeweler perks making some stats loop to infinity.
Fixed a bug where the experience bar showed as full past 2^31 experience points.
Fixed a bug where a socketed deviant cell charm could not be upgraded with standard of heroes.
Fixed a bug where repairing equipment sometimes did not work with an error message.
Fixed an issue where Sa rune did not rune forge the right bonuses.
Fixed a few monsters not dropping the right items.
Fixed some outdated information on the endgame maps page.
Fixed a lot of dragon stoning bugs.
Fixed a bug where ancient scrolls could not be downgraded.
Fixed a few documentation errors.
Fixed a few cube recipe bugs.
Added all ancient artefacts to the currency stash tab.
Power Overwhelming
- Gemwords can no longer be made into magic items.
You can no longer add sockets to magic items the regular way if you have “Power Overwhelming” perk (to avoid missocketing).
Recipes that rerolled charms now output a charm of the same type.
Athulua’s Wisdom
- Now starts with 10% to all speeds.
Fixed a bug where elemental dragon stoning recipe required a forging hammer instead of a void shard.
Fixed a bug where characters started with a -1% resistance penalty.
Added a bunch of missing in-game wiki files.
Fixed a tyrael might recipe being repeatable.
Fixed a bug where elixir of reincarnation was not craftable.
Hovering over physical and magic resists
Fixed a bug where alien artefacts could drop for anyone.
Fixed hireling panel being broken.
Fixed a bug where unique small and grand charms could not be socketed with perfect form.
Fixed a bug where rings and amulets socketed with sanctified jewels could not be sanctified (and rings or amulets already sanctified with a sanctified jewel instead could be sanctified again).
Fixed whirlwind proccing 3 times more melee attack procs than intended.
Fixed whirlwind crashing in rare cases.
Fixed a bug where jewels that gained mod through cube recipes (other than recipes that returned the same jewel back) couldn’t have their mods doubled by brilliant quality perk.
Reduced drop chances by 2.5 - 5 times (more reduction at higher levels).
Diablo
- Reduced lightning inferno damage by 50%.
Radament
- Halved defense in normal.
Alchemist
Unstable Mixtures
- Reduced chance from 15% to 10%.
Transmutation
- Reduced chance from 50% to 25%.
Added all elixirs and mystical shards to the currency tab.

Now when trying to do a weapon swap while the character is in mid animation, the swap is queued and performed after the current animation finishes. Previously, the swap performed during an animation would get dropped completely, which meant you had to wait for an animation to finish and time the key press.
Orb of anointment can now be recycled to 2 Dragon Stones using a key.
Fixed a bug where head of the cerberus and ravenlore were not limiting wolves to 1.
Goblins are no longer counted towards den of evil’s progress.
Fixed various forging bugs.
Disabled a bunch of debug routines that were slowing down the game.
Fixed a bug where The Ties that Bind rings could not drop.
Fixed valkyrie defense display.
Fixed Calamity being broken.
Fixed introductory book false information about respeccing being free.
Fixed Yaerius’ Celestial Beacon consuming ammo (you need to get a new one for this fix).
Fixed a bug where voidforge was not working as intended.
Bleed damage now displays up to 2 decimals for duration.
The door back to the icecrown citadel now opens after killing the eternal ancients.
Moved Divinity aura to a level 30 position to reflect the level requirements.
Attempted to fix a lag issue for lucion’s arena.
Fixed a few drop rates related bugs:
Certain monsters dropping items that were better than intended while being desecrated.
Certain monsters in some endgame maps dropping loot from another map pool.
Certain champion monsters were dropping boss loot.
Certain monsters were not dropping worldstone shards as intended.
Added a bunch of missing animations for warlock for charge, drain soul, leap etc.
Undead frenzy can now be used while shapeshifted.

Fixed a bug where converted weapon damage to poison length was being averaged up by other poison sources. This led to arbitrarily small damage poison sources pushing up the duration of converted weapon damage poison sources, which led to those dealing absurdly high damage. This means certain skills or procs will make a return: Poison Enhanced Spike Nova/Arrow/Axe, certain skills converting weapon damage to poison etc.
Fixed a bug where larger versions of certain unique charms could not be upgraded with standard of heroes.
Fixed a bug where certain kanji runewords could not be made with certain jewels.
Fixed a bug where raised kornac would not gain resistance bonuses from summon resist stats.
Fixed a bug where mercenaries were not proccing cast on cast procs.
Added weapon mastery token description for warlock on the weapon mastery page.
Fixed a bug where a defunct version of the tyrael’s set would show up on chronicle.
Entropy locket can be converted to devil’s food points now.
Fixed a bug where tier 5 for ascendancies could be transmuted over and over again.

Fixed a bug where whirlwind would proc “every x attack” procs all the time. Now every attack in whirlwind is counted as a third of a regular attack for the purpose of those procs (so every 15 swings in whirlwind will proc 3 “every 5 attacks” procs). This is done because whirlwind hits so much faster than any other melee attack, with the added convenience that you can reposition while spinning.
Fixed a rare crash issue that happened when hirelings had very specific items equipped (crash reason for Enkerzan).
Fixed a bug with shadow warrior and master having hidden stats.
Added the wiki created by Sully to the game (thanks sully). You can either set a hotkey for this or open it from the cube button / main menu.

Changed how auras grant stats. Previously, auras were not able to grant a value of 0 in a stat if it previously granted a non-zero number (it would refuse to take the 0 branch for performance reasons). Auras can now take 0 branches regardless of previous states, which means most items in the game with special effects will no longer grant a value of 1 in stats if conditions are not met. This was obvious with the kill ledger, for example. Please report any issues with auras.

Fixed a bug where life bonuses were lower for monsters whose levels ended in 9 (e.g. 69, 79, 89 etc.) than the previous few levels. Slightly increased life bonuses for all monsters. The life bonus should follow a much smoother curve now.
Damage of all monster spells and some non-spell abilities has been increased by ~20% at all levels.
Some spells used by monsters that were previously extremely underwhelming on higher difficulties (e.g. fallen shaman fire ball) now scale exponentially with levels, same as most spells in the game.

Some abilities that had spell damage now deal monsters’ weapon damage. Old elemental abilities convert the weapon damage to their element. This means some monsters will scale better with physical damage increasing effects, such as might, fanaticism auras, buffs etc.
Fixed a bug where the charge skill was broken for most monsters in the game. Ghastly horsemen now charge from across the screen as they did in classic ES, beware.
Reduced towering behemoth’s size by 50%.

Rare monster affixes effect is increased by 10% for every level over 100 (e.g. elemental enhanced affixes will deal 50% more total damage for level 104 monsters). Some affixes’ effect has been increased by only 5% (e.g. extra strong). The goal is to make rare affixes dangerous in endgame maps.

Reworked monster auras, they now use aura entries separate from the paladin ones. The new entries scale smoother and should be more balanced overall (might no longer one shotting you, but other misc auras being better). Auras are generally weaker early on and stronger later on.
Monster curses also use different curse entries which are weaker early on and stronger later on.
Heralds are now considered
bosses and prime evils
Fixed a bug where heralds would not roll an additional aura as intended.
Heralds now roll an additional rare affix for every tier (heralds gain 1 tier after every kill).
Drastically
reduced experience gained at higher levels (100+). Last level is 10 times harder to reach now.
Now all zones in the game belong to a group, nothing is left out.
Added 2 new terror groups which encompass most of the leftover zones, for a total of 20.
Removed the endgame map terror zones. Added 1 map to every campaign terror zone in the game.

The density of terrorized levels is increased by as much as 100%. Zones that had high density already get less density increase. Overall, all density should cap to a specific value (which is 3% chance to spawn a monster group per room). Most campaign zones had densities as low as 1.5% per room, those are boosted to 3% per room when terrorized. Zones that previously had 2.5% per room now have 3% chance etc.
This does not affect endgame maps.

The number of boss packs/champions have been increased by 3 times for all non endgame zones and by 50% for endgame zones (those zones are level 92+ zones like naraku, bookstore sarina, dark magician chamber etc.).
This does not affect endgame maps.

Got rid of the stupid system where a herald can spawn only after a % of the TZ is completed. This means you’ll be seeing between 1.5x and 2.5x more heralds in campaign zones and between 3.5x and 7x more heralds in endgame maps.
Added a global toggle to enable/disable chat notifications.
Added a new “show” rule, which forcefully shows an item that satisfies the rules. A show rule cannot be hidden by any later rule.
Added complex formula support.
You can have complex formulas for stat filtering. For example, you can show or hide items that have a 10% or more faster cast rate.
Consult the new filter guide for more details and additional help.
Fixed a bug where icons would not disappear from the minimap sometimes.
Chat notifications and sounds only play once per item now.
Tip:

It is highly encouraged that you use an advanced LLM (e.g. claude) to help yourself write rules since they’re very declarative and that’s where LLMs shine. Feed them the filter guide and describe what you want.
Completely overhauled character sheet, skill tree, inventory, advanced stats sheet and charm inventory designs.
Added magic and physical resists alongside other resistances on the character stats screen.
Changed the opacity of tooltip backgrounds from 75% to 95% for non-large font mode. This affect item tooltips, but also gold tooltip, skill tooltips etc.
Added a move only skill for all characters (including existing ones).
Also fixed charm inventory UI (thanks rexorcorum).
Integrated a bunch of better ZhCN translations into the game.
Reduced spawn chance from urns from 25% to 10% (you will be seeing 2.5 times less goblins from urns now).
Reduced drop chance of the hidden vault map by 3 times.
Added 17 new consumable elixirs to the game, 4 of which can only drop for alchemists with a certain perk learned.
All elixirs have a greater variant that can only drop for alchemists with a certain perk learned.
A 35th elixir is only obtainable with a tier 5 alchemy perk.
Elixirs have a 1/2/3/4/5% chance to drop instead of a regular potion, the chances going up further in the game.
Elixir effects scale with character level and last 45 seconds.
Reworked or slightly nerfed or buffed a few unique items and runewords to bring them more in line with other items. Changes are too many and small to list here.
Changed how all items with “Gain x% physical damage as extra elemental damage” work
. This fixes quite a few bugs:
Ele damage crits no longer double dip on spell damage (previously, ele damage crits benefited from fire/cold/lightning/poison/magic spell damage two times).
Overhauled the formulas - This increases precision at all stages.
Fixed the formulas double counting multiple stats, which led to items of this kind dealing way more damage than intended.

Fixed a bug where ele damage crits would only cause certain elements to crit at certain deadly strike values (e.g. when a player had 33% or less deadly strike, only lightning damage was allowed to crit).
Nerfed Voidforge.
Added two new sprites for jewels - obsidian and skull. Those have a function for the jeweler specialization.
All mythical bases can roll the maximum number of sockets possible for their base now.
Cloak (body armor) now has a quality level of 5.
Elemental orbs and orb of creation can no longer be transferred to shared stash.

Reworked the durability curve for all items in the game. Lighter items should have more durability in general. The durability difference between the highest level within that tier and the lowest level should be less or equal to 30%. Increased the maximum durability of gloves, belts, boots from ~25-27 to 50. Overall, your items have more durability.
Added more quality affixes and made some of them rarer.
Orb of Anointment
- Now respects the item type it anoints (for example, bow only skills can no longer spawn on axes).
Added a new stat: +x to Maximum Curses - allows you to apply more curses
Added a new stat: +x% Increased Effect of Socketed Gems - self explanatory
Added a new stat: +x% Increased Effect of Socketed Runes - self explanatory
Added a new stat: +x% Increased Effect of Socketed Jewels- self explanatory
Added a new stat: +x% Increased Effect of Gems/Runes/Jewels Socketed in this Item - same as the stats above, except those affect only the item the stat spawns on.
Added a new stat: +x% Utility Potion Effectiveness - increases the effect of utility potions (elixirs).
Added a new stat: +x% Utility Potion Duration - increases the duration of utility potions (elixirs).
Added a new stat: +x% Crushing Blow Damage - increases the damage of crushing blows against all monster types.
Crossbows now reload 25% faster overall while standing still (also goes above the reload cap).
Fixed a display bug where the damage bonus displayed as 50% instead of 150%.
Reduced total damage granted by crossbows from 150% to 100%.
Reduced minimum base reload speed from 3 seconds to 2.4 seconds.
Added a new system called specializations. Specializations are unlocked by killing strong enemies in endgame level zones and transmuting
Mystical Shards
to get a
Mystical Tesseract

which can be used to unlock specializations and get a specialization point. More points are unlocked automatically at levels 45, 60, 75 and 90. If your character is already over those levels, the token will grant points according to your level (e.g. you will get 3 points if you use the token at level 63).
There are 4 specializations:
Alchemist - Specialized on potions.
Blacksmith - Specialized on weapons and armor.
Jeweler - Specialized on jewelry, gems and jewels.
Archaeologist - Specialized in drops, coupons, runes, special artefacts.
Each specialization has 15 perks, 3 perks per row. You can choose 1 perk out of 3 for each row. You can have a maximum of 5 points.
You can respec individual perks by shift clicking a perk. This requires 5 respec points (equivalent to 20 dragon stones).
If you want to change your specialization, you need to respec all perks in the old specialization, then you will be able to pick a new specialization.
The perks are too many to list here, check them in-game.
Legendary Arrow
- Reduced weapon damage from 45% to 40%.
Magic Arrow
- Fixed a bug where the delayed star nova synergy dealt ~10-15 times more damage than intended. Increased star number from 6 to 8.
Weapon Mastery Token (Reflex Bow)
- Reworked partially.
Tornado Shot
- No longer makes it shoot a projectile nova. Instead, reduces 2% weapon damage, but pulls all nearby enemies towards the tornadoes.
Legendary Arrow

- Removed the damage/attack rating penalty/bonus. Now spawns 25% more projectiles after a 2.4 seconds delay, but reduces weapon damage by 5%. Math works out at ~11% more total damage if including the extra projectiles.
Traps
Start shooting the instant they are placed.
Credit kills to their owner. This includes all on kill skills, life and mana on kill etc.
Wake of Destruction
- Reworked their attack, they now fire a flame wave similar to the one that warlock uses.
Swapped Venom and Shade Armor places.
Flurry of Shurikens, Shuriken Trap, Ricochet
- Added damage bonus per level and synergy for damage bonus. Added poison damage conversion synergy from venom.
Stun, Hatchet Flurry, Frenzy
- Adjusted mana cost at level 1 and mana per level to match other level 1 skills (1 + 0.25 per level). Frenzy and hatchet flurry are not interruptible.
Whirlwind
- No longer allows you to spin in place under any circumstances (you can still spin in place against a wall).
Ravens
- They are now
ranged
. Thunderclaws is now a ranged skill that fires several lightning bolts. Reduced thunderclaws base damage by 10%.
Sanctuary

- The undead and demon damage stats have a significantly better contribution at level 1 (equal to old level 40 contribution), but slightly less contribution at level 110 (new level 110 contribution is the old level 80 contribution).
Changed the visuals on Scorch, Blaze and Conflagrate (the stationary fires) in order to significantly improve fps and visibility.
Enchant
- Increased attack rating from 20% + 10% per level to 50% + 15% per level. Increased base damage substantially at all levels.
Weapon Mastery Token (Orbs)
- Now triples the cooldown of all direct damage dealing spells.
Bind Monster

- Reworked. No longer retains the stats of the original bound monster. Instead, it has a base physical damage range and a bonus spell damage amount. Reduced the physical damage bonus by ~2.5 times. It now has a default life pool of 3000 that goes up with levels, blood oath and summon life stat, all multiplicative with each other. For reference, summon skeleton king’s base life is 650. Removed spectral hit affix. Gluttony now works for bind monster as well as all other summon related stats. Bottom line, bound monsters should be more consistent now, they should deal significantly more spell damage, competitive with the physical damage of regular monsters and they should no longer be immortal due to gigantic life pools.
Reduced bound monsters limit granted by baal’s book from x2 to x1 (equal to your demon limit).
Summon Defiler
- Increased link damage share from 15% + 1% per 2 levels to 15% + 1% per level.
Fixed a bug where storing anything into the stocker would result into ancient decipherer points.
Fixed loot filters being broken (the plugin itself was not updated).

Bind monsters’ life should no longer overflow. Removed the functionality that allowed monsters and summons to surpass 8.3 million hp because it was buggy and unstable. Bind monsters’ life should now cap at 8.3 million.
Fixed a bug with the lich king not always granting the right buff to be able to transmute the kill ledger for cannot be frozen.
Attempt to fix a crash related to dying.
Fixed an issue where Vigor was not learnable.
Fixed a bug where ascending stance dancer to tier 3 would sometimes not grant the stance dancing functionality.
To fix this for existing stones, please transmute the stone with itself once
. This will add the functionality to your stone.
Fixed a bug where Something Wicked and hellfire torch were not able to roll warlock skills.
Added a few missing affixes for warlock skills (grand charm skillers, warlock skills for certain items including jewels).
All teleport abilities that deal damage (e.g. umbral flight) have their cooldown reduced by levels now.
Fixed a bug where rejuvs would not be sent to the belt when shift clicking on them in the currency tab. Instead, now
ctrl
+ left click on any beltable consumable attempts to send them in the belt first before placing them in inventory.
Evil urns no longer spawn the same type of monster per zone. Each urn will now roll a monster type independently of others.
Fixed a bug where auras on left click would sometimes deactivate.
Fixed a bug where auras could not be activated on controller.
Fixed a bug where The Soul Engine did not lower the life to 1.
Fixed a bug where non-terrorized bosses in shrine of destruction were treated as being terrorized.
Bul Kathos’ Wedding Band now requires 4 wild cards.
Fixed a bug where echoing strike would fail to return if it missed an enemy while flying.
Added a button for rerolling orb storing in the inventory UI.
Removed the stock ESR filter (that was a copy off Sully’s filter).

Filters are now pulled automatically from filter creators’ repositories. If you want to have your filter featured on the launcher, pm me and I’ll add your repository. You can still add local filters, but filters curated by the launcher are seen by everyone.
Filters now update automatically, live, whenever a filter creator pushes changes to his repository. The update diffs against the main (default) branch.
Added Sully’s filter as a curated filter to the ESR Launcher.
Unique items not in the chronicle already have additional text on their ground label that indicates that.
Chronicle also reads identified items now, effectively making it possible for coupon uniques to be completable.
Fixed a bug where spell damage was significantly rarer than intended as a base random affix.
Indestructible, total spell and total attack damage affixes are 2 times rarer now.
Highest gemwords now roll between 2 and 4 affixes instead of 3 and 4 affixes.
Goblins now have a brand new custom AI which makes them significantly more intelligent at running away from the player. After a period of 30 seconds, they open a portal and disappear.
To compensate, their movement speed has been drastically reduced, the damage dealt by their abilities have been reduced and they no longer teleport when hurt.
Goblins have a 25% chance to spawn from urns compared to other monsters (spawn chance reduced by 4 times).
Bosses no longer drop Primordial Soulstones after you have collected 10 of them.
The following skills or items drain life instead of mana while you have blood magic (if you are a blood mage): Soul Tide, Darkforce Spawn, Griffon’s Eye.
Attempting to cast a skill while you have blood magic and not enough life will reject the cast instead of using mana to cast it.
Flame Rift, Ice Blink, Lightning Warp, Venom Veil, Umbral Flight, Wind Walk
- Reduced base damage at higher levels by ~25%.
Stone Skin
- No longer stuns players when hit. Increased cooldown from 10 to 15 seconds.
Mythical uniques can now be converted to 50 ancient decipherer points in the multistocker.
Death’s Fathom
- Uncapped Vengeful Spirit’s bonus damage from cold resist.
The Belt of Zeus
- Reduced Lightning Warp oskill bonus from 10-30 to 10-15.
Chillcobble
- Increased Ice Blink oskill bonus from 5-10 to 10-15.
Fireheart’s Hand
- Added Flame Rift oskill, 10-15.
The 3 elite LoD warlock books now make consume last permanently and save upon exiting the game. The extra monsters bound with the help of ars’tor-baalos are also saved upon exiting the game now.
Steel Carapace
- Reduced lightning spell damage granted from 1% per 2 lightning resist to 1% per 4 lightning resist.
Items that grant oskill and skill bonus to the same skill (e.g. ascendancies) now sum those bonuses under an (All Classes) modifier.
Girdle of Giant Strength
- Now grants 1% bonus strength per 400 vitality instead of 1000 max life in order to avoid a feedback loop with tyrael’s might.
Thawing and Antidote Potions
- No longer grant maximum resistances.
Fist of the Heavens
- Fixed holy bolts not dealing damage.
Increased damage of traps significantly at lower levels and by a smaller amount at higher levels.
Eldritch Blast
- Fixed a bug where eldritch blast was gaining 10 times more damage per level than intended. Increased base damage by ~50% at all levels.
Added a bunch of warlock skills as oskills to vessel of souls.
Bind Demon’s life should no longer overflow now, which led to it instantly dying if his life went over ~8.3 million.
Fixed uber baal casting cold enhanced affix spell on the client side instead of his own spells.
Fixed a bug where certain gemwords could have their sockets removed.
Fixed a bug where giant wrap belts could not roll tinkering points. They now also come with a small strength bonus by default.
Fixed missing strings for hirelings.
Fixed chat notifications for loot filters.
Fixed map bosses not having a guaranteed chance to drop worldstone shards.
Fixed herald names and terror zones colors.
Fixed some outdated info on the documentation.
Created a new page for corruption and anointment outcomes, compressed both pages into 1. Added standard of heroes and sanctification bonuses outcomes to this page.
Did some cleanup.
Fixed a few issues with the IAS calculator and whirlwind.
Reworked affixes for ubers, each uber boss now has a rare affix manually selected and only one. This applies for key and tristram ubers.
Mephisto: Will retain his conviction.
Baal: Resistant
Duriel: Stone Skin
Izual: Cold Enhanced
Lilith: Mana Burn
Diablo: Spectral Hit
Changed default spawn affixes on nihlathak’s superuniques.
Reduced Extra Strong damage physical damage bonus from 150% to 100% (matches the spell damage bonus now).
Fixed a few bugs related to aura enhanced on monsters. Changed the auras rare enemies can spawn with, added a few new auras to the pool.
Waypoints now activate automatically when close to them (credits to Collin, reimagined creator).
Darkshade Set
- Changed on melee attack surges to on striking.
Reduced drop chance of Ancient Scrolls by 50%.
Whirlwind

- Modified the attack speed formula for whirlwind. It is now harder to reach the last attack speed breakpoints for all weapons. Extremely fast weapons (e.g. crystal swords) are now significantly slower without attack speed investment. The last IAS breakpoint is now 6 frames instead of 4 (you can now attack at most 8.33 times per second while dual wielding, down from 12.5 attacks per second, no matter how much attack speed you have; the attacks per second for a single weapon being half of that at 4.16). Now all weapons can reach the 6 fpa breakpoint with enough investment. Reasoning: Whirlwind was by far the strongest and most convenient skill in the entire game. This is meant to dial back a lot of that power early game and make it slightly worse late game.
Demons
- Summoned demons are now summed under a single icon. This includes bound monsters.
Fixed unique jewel reroll not working, also updated it in the docs.
Fixed a plugin conflict.
Fixed a bug where Spirit of Nature was not invincible with heart of the oak.
Fixed a bug where summons would still show up as immune to elements in certain cases, despite their resistances capping at 75% (50% for phys).
Fixed rerolling orb not being able to output a magic warlock ring with 3->1 recipe.
Harbinger of Ruin set now has a grimoire instead of a shield.
Fixed a bug where bind demon would roll invalid auras.
Fixed a bug where gem 6packs were 2 times cheaper than intended.
Fixed a bug where auras on left click would not reread their current level on ticking, which made Divinity not gain skill bonuses from itself.
Fixed a bug where a player’s own pierce stats would count towards allies monster resistance display.
Fixed a crash issue related to sounds for act 4 seal bosses (leoric and lachdanan). For real this time.
Fixed a bug where 7 rare jewels would not transmute into 1 unique jewel outside the rerolling orb.
Fixed Secret Recipe 38 not working.
Updated introductory book with new information.
You can no longer downgrade scrolls 1 by 1 outside of stash to avoid ruining your scroll.
You can now configure in d2rloader settings whether you want to hide or show stat ranges on items and if you want to show maximum number of sockets or not.
Added a “skip all shared stash items” checkbox for rerolling orb functionality.

Completely overhauled the superior affixes system. Superior items have a much bigger pool of affixes to choose from now and they are now weighted. Rarer affixes are more powerful generally. Extended the system to more item types than before.
Added a new documentation page under the suffixes page called [Quality Affixes].
Added evil urns to all areas in the game that have monsters.
Spawn chance of urns is now 2/4/6% per room per difficulty. Room means a relatively small section of a level. You should be able to see evil urns fairly often on hell, for example.
Bosses inside the urns have 1 additional rare affix.
Note:
3 plugins were merged into 1, you will get a missing plugin warning. Ignore it.
Added the missing rerolling orb functionality to the launcher. The launcher will now be kept in sync with ESR version so this doesn’t happen again.
Fixed Girdle of Giant Strength not stacking.
Unique jewels can now be rune forged up to o rune.
Transfer to stash button now has the option to left + click it to transfer everything in inventory and cube to shared stash (everything that does not fit in the special tabs).
Transmute now works much faster when the key is held.
Fixed a display bug for phasing affix.
Fixed a bug with Verdungo’s Hearty Cord effect not stacking.
Fixed a bug where magic find past ~2000% was not being counted at all.
Fixed a bug where staves were considered polearms/spears.
Fixed a bug where spirit of nature was not invulnerable with heart of the oak equipped.
Fixed a bug where hsarus set was the one restricted to drop in cow level instead of the cow king’s set.
Bul kathos wedding ring and carrion wind coupons are now considered elite coupons for the purpose of rerolling.
Fixed culling strike on items not counting gold find, magic find and not proccing on death effects of bosses and monsters.
Fixed ballistas dealing 100 times more damage than intended.
Added autostocker support for rerolling orb built in the ESRLauncher.
Removed changelogs page.
Added a dropdown to change modes between grouped and expanded on suffixes and prefixes page. Grouped mode is a new mode that groups affixes by item types and compacts them. (old functionality)
Tinkering Points
- Now show up on items.
All summons
are now saved on exiting the game and loaded upon entering.
Fixed a bug where bind demon was not saveable on a non-warlock character (e.g. augury set).
Fixed an issue where icons were not drawn properly on the minimap and would sometimes be drawn on the screen directly. Icons are fully supported now.
Fixed an issue where the light beam effects could not be colored. Now the beam can be fully colored in any color.
Items hidden by the filter can no longer be picked up at all.
Reduced power growth of gemwords from 50% per gem tier to ~35%.
Flame Wave
- Increase direct base damage by 50% and lingering fire base damage by 100%.
Seeking Flames
- Splits an additional time now.
Hellfire Bolt
- Increased the lingering fire base damage by ~80% (more at higher levels).
Miasma Bolt, Miasma Chains
- Increased base damage over time by ~80% (more at higher levels).
Fixed a bug where lucion was still unkillable.
Fixed a bug where a few sounds were missing from king leoric and lachdanan in act 4 chaos sanctuary. Also attempt to fix a few related crashes.
Fixed Secret Recipe 50 description.
Fixed perfect obsidian 6pack missing the sprite.
Improved and enhanced the functionality of loot filters. Added new functionality.
Droplight
- You can add droplights to rules and you can even change the color of the light now.
Sounds
- Volume can be configured on a rule by rule basis.
Minimap Icons
- You can now add icons for the minimap in the sprite format. They get pulled from LootFilters/icons.
More features documented in the guide that ships with the new update.

Fix attempt for a crash related to leoric in act 4.
Fixed sets accepting stats from cube recipes on their set bonuses
. Now stats are applied on the base affix pool.
Fixed a bug where items with too many stats would crash the game on adding even more stats
. An obvious example of this is the kill ledger.

Fixed elzix selling the same arrow quiver at gamble.

Reduced the defense granted by madawc’s shout.

Added localization for all of in-game languages to the documentation as well.

- Now requires a perfect gem instead of a Sa rune.
Orb of Anointment
- Can no longer be converted into maple leaves. Instead, it can be converted into 2 dragon stones when transmuted with a key.
Frenzy for monsters now grants significantly less damage bonus and deals less weapon damage.
Ancient Scrolls
- Reduced drop rates of scrolls by ~25%.
Readded gem 6packs, can downgrade them to perfect gems directly in stash.
Fix attempt for a king leoric related crash.
Fixed a bug where character saves would not load into the game main window if they went over an arbitrary 16kb limit.
Spirit of nature now provides spell damage as intended.
Added missing Worldstone Shard to the currency tab.
Item description for currency items (e.g. Ancient Scrolls) now show up while the item is in the stash.
Certain affixes no longer show on boss minions (e.g. ele enhanced, stone skin etc.) since those do not affect minions in any way.
Fixed a bug where hellfire torch could not be upgraded with the standard of heroes.
Fixed a bug where branded items could still be modified by specific recipes.
Fixed a bug where some Void Shard recipes were not working (for dragon stoning).
Fixed a bug where recipes 37 and 38 were not working.
Fixed a bug where champion and boss monsters would not drop loot in labyrinth of suffering.
Fixed a bug where ballistas and poison sentry did not work.

Restored King Leoric’s (act 4 seal boss) sound set.
Fixed Smif’s Stone not being able to spawn warlock skills.
Fixed a bug where empty rows would show up in the advanced stash panel.
Fixed a bug where Vessel of Souls could not roll warlock skills.
Fixed a bug where you could equip multiple unique charms in charm inventory.
Fixed a bug where transmuting primordial soulstones with an ascendancy stone would not grant the correct number of souls captured, making it unable for the stone to ever ascend to tier 4.
Now also works while the cube is closed and you can now hold the transmute hotkey to transmute constantly back to back.
Raven Frost, Dwarf Star
- Reworked.
The Ties that Bind
- Re-enabled. Changed them a bit, for the better.
Whirlwind
- Fixed a bug where the splash part would not gain the right amount of attack rating. Reduced weapon damage from 150% to 100% and splash weapon damage from 100% to 75%. Now a level 12 skill.
Frenzy
- Reduced weapon damage from 150% to 125%. Now a level 1 skill
Axe Swarm
- Reworked into
Warpath

, now a level 30 skill. Passive, grants you a chance to summon 4 twisters on attacking while whirlwinding. Chance goes up with levels, 10% + 0.4% per level. Also makes frenzy attack 0.08 seconds faster at warpath levels 20, 50 and 80. This attack speed goes beyond the fpa cap for frenzy, which makes it possible to hit a 2fpa frenzy (12.5 hits per second).
Bind Demon
- Fixed the demon getting malformed auras. Now it can choose from any paladin aura, except holy fire, freeze, shock.
Stone Skin
- Reduced duration from 10 to 5 seconds, but increased total absorb from 25% to 50% of maximum life. Total regen is halved.
Teleport
- Increased proc chance from 50% to 100% and cooldown from 2 to 4 seconds.

Improved how the launcher operates on your files. It should no longer delete global plugins you have installed for other mods. Also, Eastern Sun no longer uses global plugins since this mod experience is tailored directly by the included plugins and external plugins are not intended to work with Eastern Sun due to game balance or existing systems breaking.
Added missing sprites for some unique items.
Fixed terror zones groupings.
Fixed Mirrored Blades’ description and damage display.
Fixed a bug where achievement were not counted on steam if the game was started through launcher.
Global plugins no longer apply when ESR is running. This should stabilize the game a bit.
Stone Skin
- Added an overlay to make it more visible while active. Reduced stun duration on hitting the enemy from 1 second to 0.2 seconds.
Throne room diablo has ~40% less life now.

Fixed diablo dealing insane damage with his cold claw.
Fixed apocalypse and abyss providing resistance at higher levels instead of lowering it.
Added loot filter support in the ESRLauncher. I took the liberty to convert Sully’s filter.

To use a loot filter: open the ESR Launcher, go to the Loot Filter tab, click Import filter and pick the filter's .json file. To edit one of ESR's filters, click it, then Copy to my filters, then Open folder, and edit the copy in a text editor. Changes show up in game as soon as you save.
